WITH city_attendee_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zc.city,
    COUNT(*) as num_attendees
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  JOIN zip_code zc ON m.zip = zc.zip_code
  GROUP BY zc.city
),
city_attendance_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cac.city,
    cac.num_attendees,
    CAST(cac.num_attendees AS FLOAT) / 
      (SELECT SUM(num_attendees) FROM city_attendee_counts) as attendance_share
  FROM city_attendee_counts cac
),
avg_share_across_cities AS (
  SELECT AVG(attendance_share) as avg_attendance_share
  FROM city_attendance_shares
),
above_avg_share_cities AS (
  SELECT 
    cas.num_attendees,
    cas.attendance_share,
    cas.attendance_share - aac.avg_attendance_share as share_above_avg
  FROM city_attendance_shares cas
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_across_cities aac
  WHERE cas.attendance_share > aac.avg_attendance_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(num_attendees) as avg_attendees,
  AVG(attendance_share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share_above_avg) as avg_amount_above_average
FROM above_avg_share_cities;
